'''Operation: Undertow''' was a covert operation carried out by [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] on behalf of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] sometime after the operative known as [[Watcher X]] joined Intelligence in [[3664 BBY]]. The operation resulted in a re-evaluation of Watcher X's service, and the agent was reassigned to the [[Shadow Town]] prison district on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Intelligence Profile: Watcher X}}</ref> [[Fixer Seven]] was involved in the operation, and he was one of the few agents who survived the mission&mdash;though he suffered intense injuries in the process.<ref name="Message">{{TORcite|type=message|Follow-up on Watcher X|Fixer Seven}}</ref>
